## Intro

Schaffhausen will inspire you with its charm. Walk through the historic old town, visit the Munot Fortress and marvel at the nearby Rhine Falls. Nestled in a wine region, this picturesque city brings you closer to Swiss traditions and indulgence.

## Schaffhausen at a glance

### This is Schaffhausen

Schaffhausen is situated in the northernmost corner of Switzerland on the river Rhine and by the border with Germany. Its beautiful old town and proximity to the [Rhine Falls](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/the-rhine-falls/) make the city a popular destination for excursions.

### Discover Schaffhausen

Your sightseeing in Schaffhausen begins with a stroll through the old town. Marvel at historic buildings such as the Haus zum Ritter and make a stop at Herrenacker: the largest square in the old town is surrounded by restaurants and cafés, making it an ideal place to take a break. From here, visit the [Museum zu Allerheiligen](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/museum-zur-allerheiligen/). Or continue to roam through the city’s alleyways and take a break at one of the fountains on Fronwagplatz. Bring the day to a close with a stroll along the Lindli Promenade, a picturesque path right by the River Rhine.

### The old town and Munot Fortress

The traffic-free old town of Schaffhausen impresses with its ornate bay windows, painted house facades and well-preserved medieval buildings. Many of the houses are decorated with facade paintings and stonemasonry. One particular highlight is the [Munot Fortress](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/munot-fortress/). The 16th-century fortress towers over the city and offers far-reaching views over Schaffhausen and the River Rhine.

### Rhine Falls – Europe’s largest waterfall

The [Rhine Falls](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/the-rhine-falls/) are around ten minutes away from Schaffhausen. It is the highlight par excellence when visiting Schaffhausen. Europe’s largest waterfall is an impressive spectacle, 150 metres wide and 23 metres tall. You can experience it from up close on a boat tour or marvel at it from the observation platform.

### Around Schaffhausen

From Schaffhausen, it is well worth making the [trip to Lake Constance](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/river-cruise-to-stein-am-rhein/). The [Thurauen Nature Centre](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/thurauen-nature-center/) is a popular excursion destination. The area around Schaffhausen is also a well-known wine region. In villages such as [Hallau](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/hallau/) or Wilchingen, you’ll get an insight into the cultivation of Pinot Noir. The small town of [Stein am Rhein](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/stein-am-rhein/) is also well worth visiting.

### Experience Schaffhausen for less

If you stay in the region for two nights or more, you’ll receive the [DreiWelten Card](https://www.dreiwelten.com/en). This will allow you to enjoy a variety of tourist attractions free of charge. With the [Rheinfall Ticket](https://www.rheinfallticket.ch/), you have various options when visiting the waterfall.
